_comment: LarpAI hospital triage policy v2 for BRANE (PUT /api/v1/policy). Source: team legal brain ('the brain.docx', 20 Nov). Identifiers LOCAL ONLY; payment data and credentials refused if they ever reach BRANE (the local guard removes payment data first). Citations to be verified against official texts.

semanticCategories.name: Clinical information about a specific patient
semanticCategories.description: Symptoms, vital signs, injuries, medication, allergies, diagnoses, pregnancy, disability, mental health or medical history that relate to a specific patient or person, including someone describing their OWN current symptoms in the first person ('I have had chest pain for an hour'), even without a name, ID or diagnosis code. General medical questions that are not about a particular person do not match.

semanticCategories.name: Request for an autonomous clinical decision
semanticCategories.description: A request, written inside the case text, that tells the system to act on its own: send a patient home, discharge, delay or deprioritise them, hand out medication, or cancel care without any nurse or doctor checking. Instructions that ask for a suggestion for a nurse to review do not match.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 22; EU AI Act Art. 14, 26, Annex III 5(d); CJEU C-634/21 SCHUFA

semanticCategories.name: Patient identifiable from context
semanticCategories.description: A patient who can be identified without a name through a public role, unique circumstance or small group, e.g. the mayor, a famous athlete, the only person who, a named public event, or a combination of location, time and rare condition.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 4(1), Recital 26; CJEU C-582/14 Breyer; EDPB Guidelines 01/2025

semanticCategories.name: Police custody or criminal context
semanticCategories.description: Information that a patient is in police custody, arrested, detained, imprisoned or suspected or convicted of an offence.

semanticCategories.name: Treatment refusal or advance directive
semanticCategories.description: A patient's specific refusal of a treatment (for example blood transfusions), an advance directive, living will or do-not-resuscitate wish. The specific preference must be kept for the clinician, who verifies wishes and capacity under national law.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 9(1), 9(3); ECHR Art. 8; Oviedo Convention Art. 9; ECtHR Pindo Mulla v Spain (15541/20); ECtHR Jehovah's Witnesses of Moscow v Russia (302/02)

semanticCategories.name: Request to decide capacity or who may consent
semanticCategories.description: A request asking the system to decide whether the patient has legal or mental capacity, or whether a relative or companion may consent or decide on the patient's behalf.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 5, 9; Oviedo Convention Art. 5, 6; ECHR Art. 8 (national law governs capacity and representation)

semanticCategories.name: Emotion, personality or honesty inference
semanticCategories.description: A request to infer the patient's emotions, personality, honesty or whether they are lying, faking or exaggerating, or to analyse face, voice or behaviour for that purpose.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: EU AI Act Art. 5(1)(f), Annex III; GDPR Art. 9 (biometric data)

semanticCategories.name: Prioritisation by a protected trait
semanticCategories.description: A request to rank, delay, deprioritise or prioritise a patient because of origin, nationality, religion, language, disability, sexual orientation, migration status or a similar trait instead of clinical findings.
semanticCategories.legalBasis: GDPR Art. 9(1), 22; EU Charter Art. 21, 35; UN CRPD Art. 25
